info.name: equis.auth
info.description:
Riding Schedule — E1 auth flows (M1 trainer, W-A admin) against equis-api.

Before running:
1. Fresh dev database (V1–V5 applied): trainer 1 active, trainer 2 invited with the seeded invite token.
2. Set adminEmail and adminPassword (values behind APP_ADMIN_EMAIL / APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH). Prefer a Postman environment so the password isn't saved in the collection.

Run order: Trainer 1→4, then Admin 1→3. Admin 4 · Lockout locks the admin for 15 minutes; run it last.
Single-use data: the invite token works once. Re-running 'Trainer · 3' needs a fresh database.
Not covered here (no endpoint yet): W4 invite / reset links and disabling a trainer (E6).

item.name: Trainer (M1)
item.description: Mobile app sign-in, refresh, invite accept and role doors.

item.name: 1 · Sign in
item.description: Screen 0. Seeded trainer 1 (active) and trainer 2 (invited, no password yet).

request.description: Spaces are stripped server-side. Saves trainerAccessToken / trainerRefreshToken.
Email is lowercased server-side. rememberMe=false → refresh token lasts 7 days.
Same answer as a wrong password, so callers can't probe which phones exist.
Run BEFORE the invite is accepted (folder 3). Afterwards this login succeeds.

item.name: 2 · Refresh
item.description: Run after 1 · Sign in. Refresh rotates the pair; reusing an old refresh token is refused.

request.description: The app calls refresh when its access token has expired. The bearer header is ignored on /auth/**.
Reuse detection. Depending on your rule this may also revoke the newer token; log in again afterwards if needed.

item.name: 3 · Invite accept (set password)
item.description: Invite link page. Uses the seeded trainer 2 invite token. The link is single-use: after 'Accept invite' succeeds, re-running needs a fresh database (or a new invite once W4 exists in E6).

item.name: Password too short → 400, link not used

request.description: 7 bytes fails the 8–72 byte rule. The link stays usable.
Sets the password and makes trainer 2 active. Does not sign in.
Same answer as used or expired links.

item.name: 4 · Role doors
item.description: Until E2 adds real /me endpoints, an allowed call passes the guard and gets 404 (no handler). The check is 'not 401/403'.

request.description: Changes the last character of the trainer's access token.

item.name: Admin (W-A)
item.description: Web console sign-in, refresh, role doors and lockout.

item.name: 1 · Sign in
item.description: Screen W0. Admin seeded by V5 from APP_ADMIN_EMAIL / APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH. Set adminEmail and adminPassword first.

request.description: A correct login also resets the failed-attempt counter.
Counts toward the lock. Run 'Admin login' afterwards to reset the counter.

item.name: 3 · Role doors
item.description: Until W1 endpoints exist (E2), an allowed call passes the guard and gets 404.

item.name: 4 · Lockout (locks the admin for 15 minutes)
item.description: Run this folder last and on its own. It locks the admin account. Unlock with the recovery CLI: docker compose exec -it api java -jar /app/app.jar --spring.profiles.active=admin-cli unlock <admin email> — or wait 15 minutes.

request.description: The password isn't even checked while locked.
